supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:51 UTC, the workstation received an HTTP 200 response for a PowerShell script at raw.githubusercontent.com/harbor-dental-it/tools/main/u.ps1. The proxy record shows no user-agent; it does not establish that the script was executed.

At 13:37:40 UTC, the workstation accessed drive.google.com and its My Drive page. Google Drive is not among the approved services listed in the environment context, but these records do not establish that files were transferred.
At 13:40:53 UTC, the workstation connected to DC-HD-01 over SMB. The DC recorded a network logon for the workstation machine account, WS-MLOPEZ-01$, not a named user account.

The script download, unapproved cloud-service access, and SMB connection are suspicious in context, but the available records do not link them to one another or establish malicious execution or impact.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show proxy metadata for the GitHub request, not the script contents, hash, or execution result (T003-00214).
The supplied records do not include a PowerShell process-start or PowerShell script-content event around the reported time; this does not establish that PowerShell did not run.
The SMB record shows a connection and machine-account logon, but does not identify the accessed share, files, or operations (T003-00248, T003-00249).
The Google Drive records show page access, not whether a file was uploaded, downloaded, or viewed (T003-00181, T003-00200).

Whether any files were transferred to or from Google Drive.

Whether the reported PowerShell window corresponds to the GitHub request or the SMB activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve endpoint process and command-line telemetry, PowerShell Operational logs (including script-block logging if enabled), and EDR records for WS-MLOPEZ-01 around 13:35–13:50 UTC.
Obtain the downloaded script and its hash, then verify the repository, commit, author, and authorization with the responsible IT team.
Review DC-HD-01 SMB and file-access auditing for the workstation connection at 13:40:53 UTC.
